# Vieren

> Vieren is a one man hybrid production studio in Cape Town, run by Richard Van der Vieren. He is a photographer, filmmaker and author. He fuses a rare overlap of deep technical skill and world-class creative craft.

Contact: hello@vieren.studio

## Who

- Name: Richard Van der Vieren
- Base: Cape Town, South Africa
- Roles: photographer, filmmaker, author, builder of AI and automation tools
- Author of the book Wolvenkinderen (Dutch, 2018, ISBN 9789090313849), also published in Slovak as Vlčie deti (with Baša Števulová, ISBN 9788057052937). The book helps parents trade screen time for outdoor adventures and open fire cooking: https://wolfchildren.co
- Curates the Vimeo channel Awesomeness, followed by 85,000 people: https://vimeo.com/channels/awesomeness

## Services

- Strategy, Ideation & Distribution
- AI & Automation Consultancy
- Photography (booking a few shoots per month in Cape Town)
- Video Production
- Bulk Content Production

## Case studies

- [Anticitizen](https://vieren.studio/case-study-anticitizen.html): winning talking-head videos turned into hundreds of variations
- [Cato Vermeulen](https://vieren.studio/case-study-cato.html): brand systems, a client portal and products for a business astrologer
- [Full Send](https://vieren.studio/case-study-fullsend.html): a pipeline from a folder of photos to daily slideshow posts
- [Macro Coach](https://vieren.studio/case-study-macro-coach.html): an AI macro coach inside a chat
- [Photo Diary](https://vieren.studio/case-study-photo-diary.html): one folder of photos feeds the site and five social platforms
